output.title: Coffee capsule filling (37 mm x 28 mm)

product.name: Aluminium coffee capsules
product.description: Small aluminium coffee capsules (37 mm diameter, 28 mm tall) filled with weighed ground coffee, tamped, sealed with a foil lid, inspected, and packed into boxes.

steps.name: LoadCapsuleBodies
steps.does: Place empty aluminium capsule bodies into the filling/tamping positions.

steps.name: WeighFillGroundCoffee
steps.does: Dispense ground coffee by weight into capsules, filled in groups of 6.

steps.name: TampCoffee
steps.does: Tamp the filled coffee to the required compaction before sealing.

steps.name: SealFoilLid
steps.does: Seal a foil lid onto each capsule using a sealing head.

steps.name: CameraCheckLidSeal
steps.does: Use a camera to check every sealed lid for seal correctness.

steps.name: RejectBadSeal
steps.does: Divert capsules with a bad seal to a reject path instead of sending them to packing.

steps.name: PackToBoxOfTen
steps.does: Pack passing capsules into boxes containing 10 capsules each.

output.quality: Bad seal verdicts detected by the camera are rejected (diverted away from packing).
constraints: Food-grade process (hygienic design, surfaces and materials suitable for food contact).
Capsules are filled in groups of 6 (the filling/tamping/sealing flow must support 6-at-a-time indexing).
assumptions: Assume an 8-hour shift because the owner only gave a per-hour target (takt = 3600 caps/hour => 1.0 s per finished capsule).
Assume foil lids are pre-kitted/pre-fed to the sealing station (no foil web forming included).
Assume camera inspection is performed after sealing and before packing, with single-capsule diversion on rejection.
Assume packing is done with individual passing capsules arriving one-by-one from inspection (accumulated/count-to-10 then boxed).
Assume only one product variant (no labeling or case-level labeling requested).

questions.question: For 'packed ten to a box': what box format do you want (just an internal divider/not, any outer carton), and are boxes reused or single-use?
questions.why: Determines the packaging station (case/box forming, tray vs carton insert, and whether a carton closer is needed).

questions.question: Is the 3600 capsules/hour achievable with the 6-at-a-time filling scheme on your current machine concept (i.e., do you already have an indexing rate for the 6-pack positions)?
questions.why: We must ensure each station can fit within the 1.0 s takt; the 6-at-a-time indexing affects station timing.

questions.question: When a bad seal is detected, where do rejected capsules go (bin for disposal, rework possibility, and do you want it immediately diverted or staged at the end)?
questions.why: Determines reject transport and buffer handling so rejects never contaminate packed product.
